book.name: Wer Mamit
book.title: Wer Mamit Moloyo Wende Moko Duto

content.text: Ka dine ibedna owadwa mahie,
mane wadhodhogo thuno achiel,
to dine anyodhi, kapo ni ayudi oko,
kendo onge ngʼama dine ochaya.
Dine amako badi, mi akeli nyaka
e od minwa kama ne opuonjae.
Dine amiyi divai moketie yedhe madungʼ tik mamit mondo imadhi;
kendo dine amiyi olemo mongʼinore makwar.
Bade ma koracham oteno wiya,
to bade ma korachwich okwaka.
Un nyi Jerusalem, asiemou ni kik
utug hera kata chiewe ka sa ne pok oromo.
Mano to ngʼa mabiro koa e piny motimo ongoro
koyiengore kuom jaherane?
Ne achiewe e bwo yadh olemo mayom;
kanyo ema ne minu omake ichni,
kendo kanyo ema ngʼat mane muoch okayo nonywolie.
Para e chunyi kinde duto,
kendo wiyi kik wil koda;
nikech hera nigi teko mana ka tho, kendo nyiego ma
hera nigo tut mana ka bur tho.
Herano liel ka mach mabebni,
kendo mana ka ligek mach maduongʼ.
Pige mathoth ok nyal nego hera;
kendo kata aore maringo ok nyal ywere.
Ka dipo ni ngʼato dichiw mwandu duto mag ode
mondo oyud hera, to mano dibed fuwo maduongʼ.
Wan gi nyaminwa moro matin,
kendo thundene pok obedo madongo.
Angʼo mwanyalo timone
nyaminwa chiengʼ ma wuowi obiro dware?
Ka dine bed ni en ohinga,
to dine wagero osuch fedha kuome.
To ka dine obed ni en dhoot,
to dine walore gi thigo mar bap sida.
An to an ohinga,
kendo thundena ochungʼ,
ka ohinga moger motingʼore gi malo.
Kuom mano, asebedone wangʼ monenogo,
kendo asemiyo obedo gi kwe.
Solomon ne nigi puoth
mzabibu kama iluongo ni Baal Hamon;
kendo ne oketo puotheno e lwet jopur.
Moro ka moro kuomgi nonego chul Solomon kilo,
apar gachiel gi nus mar fedha kuom olembene.
An to an gi puotha awuon mar mzabibu;
to in Solomon in to bed abeda gi kilo apar gachiel,
gi nusgo miyudo kuom jopur,
to un jopur un bende beduru abeda gi kilo,
ariyo gi nusgo moyudo kuom poku.
In midak e puothe mzabibu
kaachiel gi osiepeni mabudhi,
yie awinjie dwondi gie puodho kuno!
Bi wadhi, jaherana,
kendo chal gi mwanda kata le,
mamoko manie thim mochungʼ
ewi gode mopongʼ gi yedhe madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar.
